method.excluded_warmup: One short request/task; cold model loading excluded
method.fresh_prefill: Common ~8K Qwen-tokenizer records; actual DeepSeek token counts retained, typically~6.3K; no cached tokens
method.ttft: Monotonic API submission to first content/reasoning SSE delta
method.extended: One HTML code and one1600-word prose request per arm, each1024-output cap; actual output counts retained, not three-trial medians
method.ordering: Sequential XS no-draft then XS matching-draft, identical copied production adaptive routing seed; not interleaved/thermally equalized
method.quality_scope: Synthetic arithmetic/JSON/tools/SSE, marker/history smoke only; no broad quality, losslessness or community speed reproduction claim
